entries.name: ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID
entries.summary: Required env-quad var for OIDC Federation auth: the federation rule id from the Anthropic console.

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_ORGANIZATION_ID
entries.summary: Required env-quad var for OIDC Federation auth: the target organization id.

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN
entries.summary: Inline identity token (JWT) for OIDC Federation auth; alternative to ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE.

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE
entries.summary: Path to a rotating identity-token file for OIDC Federation auth.

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID
entries.summary: Optional service-account id for OIDC Federation auth.

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_SCOPE
entries.summary: Optional auth-scope override for OIDC Federation auth.

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_CONFIG_DIR
entries.summary: Overrides the config-directory root used for profile-based auth config (configs/, credentials/).

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_PROFILE
entries.summary: Selects the active profile within the config dir; falls back to <config_dir>/active_config then "default".

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_HTTP_PROXY
entries.summary: Lowest-priority HTTP proxy fallback, below HTTP_PROXY/http_proxy; propagated to ~15 downstream toolchains (npm, docker, JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS, gcloud, etc.) for spawned children.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_HTTPS_PROXY
entries.summary: Lowest-priority HTTPS proxy fallback, below HTTPS_PROXY/https_proxy.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT
entries.summary: Alias for CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE; when truthy, replaces the full system prompt with a skeletal CWD/Date-only prompt.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG
entries.summary: Enables a retry watchdog on API 429s; strictly gated to Linux + CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT="remote" (CCR/daemon workers, not local dev machines).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT
entries.summary: Truthy env override that force-enables /fork ahead of the tengu_copper_fox GB flag (default false); non-interactive sessions never see /fork regardless.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_RATE_LIMIT_TIER
entries.summary: Overrides the reported rate-limit tier on the client-constructed OAuth token object (client-side only; server remains authoritative).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBSCRIPTION_TYPE
entries.summary: Overrides the reported subscription type on the client-constructed OAuth token object; test-hook surface for Pro-trial/subscription UI.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BRIDGE_REATTACH_SESSION
entries.summary: Single-use session id for the bridge reattach handshake; read once and deleted from process.env so it does not leak into grandchildren.

provenance.note: fully consumed by the bg/bridge persistence path

entries.name: CLAUDE_BRIDGE_REATTACH_SEQ
entries.summary: Single-use sequence number to replay from on bridge reattach; read once and deleted from process.env.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT_NAME
entries.summary: Removed in v2.1.118; agent/team display context is now derived from session state (standaloneAgentContext) instead of an env override.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_TEAM_NAME
entries.summary: Removed alongside CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT_NAME in v2.1.118.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_KIND
entries.summary: Session-kind discriminator: "bg" | "daemon" | "daemon-worker" | unset (interactive). The canonical Cowork/background-session detector; there is no literal "cowork" string in the bundle.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID
entries.summary: Stable session identifier for cross-process correlation.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_NAME
entries.summary: Human-readable session name shown in the agents/Fleet view list.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_LOG
entries.summary: Path to the session log file.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_ISOLATION
entries.summary: Background-isolation mode; value "worktree" triggers runtime system-prompt rewriting instructing the agent to call EnterWorktree before editing.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_RENDEZVOUS_SOCK
entries.summary: Unix-socket path for daemon<->worker IPC; used to send shutdown signals to idle/retired workers (tengu_bg_retired).

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_SOURCE
entries.summary: Records where a background session was spawned from (set by the daemon when dispatching workers).

entries.name: CLAUDE_JOB_DIR
entries.summary: Per-job state directory: worktree, transcript, and PTY recording all live here.

entries.name: CLAUDE_PTY_RECORD
entries.summary: File path for terminal-stream recording via the internal --bg-pty-host <sock> <cols> <rows> -- <file> argv mode.

entries.name: CLAUDE_AGENT
entries.summary: Agent identifier set when running as a Fleet/agent-view-tracked agent.

entries.name: CLAUDE_AGENTS_SELECT
entries.summary: Pre-selected agent id to highlight in the agents (Fleet) view; set when the left-arrow keybinding spawns a child "claude agents" process.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT
entries.summary: Internal agent identity for the Claude Code instance, parallel to the agent-config concept.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_HIDE_CWD
entries.summary: UI privacy knob: when truthy, blanks the cwd field in the status-line/header display (does not affect actual cwd). Useful for screensharing.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_VERIFY_PROMPT
entries.summary: Debugging-workflow discipline toggle, NOT a safety gate: injects a 3-step reproduce->fix->re-observe instruction section into the system prompt. Sibling GB flag: tengu_sparrow_ledger.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_CLASSIFIER_SUMMARY
entries.summary: Manual override for classifier-summary engine selection: truthy -> "llm", falsy -> "heuristic"; bypasses GB-flag-driven default.

entries.name: CLAUDE_INTERNAL_FC_OVERRIDES
entries.summary: Internal function-calling overrides; no user-facing surface as of v2.1.119.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DAEMON_COLD_START
entries.summary: Daemon cold-start mode: "transient" (silent on-demand, default) or "ask" (prompt before starting). There is no persistent/installed mode in v2.1.120.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_LEAN_PROMPT
entries.summary: Manual override forcing all leanable prompt sections (per-section, distinct from wholesale CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE) to their slim variants regardless of GB-flag rollout state.

entries.name: CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_GUIDELINES
entries.summary: Cowork's memory-injection bypass: when set and auto-memory is enabled, wholesale replaces the entire memory pipeline output with the env var's content (no team memory, no MEMORY.md index).

entries.name: CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_EXTRA_GUIDELINES
entries.summary: Additive Cowork memory-guidance hint, pre-existing since v2.1.118; sibling of the replace-form CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_GUIDELINES added in v2.1.120.

entries.name: CLAUDE_AGENTS_AUTO_RELAUNCHED_AT
entries.summary: Daemon-set timestamp on auto-relaunched workers; rate-limited to agents unfocused >=1h and >=6h since the last relaunch.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOWS
entries.summary: Tri-state availability override for Dynamic Workflows (the Workflow tool): truthy pulls from tengu_workflows_enabled, explicit-false disables, unset falls through to Statsig+plan default.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS
entries.summary: Hard kill switch for Dynamic Workflows, checked before org policy/availability.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_COORDINATOR_MODE
entries.summary: Enables the coordinator dispatch role (worker-team orchestration, TeamCreate/TeamDelete); remote/headless-gated.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL
entries.summary: Global effort-tier pin overriding the per-model default (low|medium|high|xhigh|max), clamped to model capability.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE
entries.summary: Truthy downgrades Opus 4.8 to Opus 4.6 (the inverse direction of the older 4.6->4.7 fast-mode var).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_OPUS_4_7_FAST_MODE
entries.summary: Opt-in fast mode for Opus 4.7. Removed in v2.1.159 (the 4.6->4.7-era fast-mode var was retired alongside the Opus 4.8 launch) but reappears as a live, functioning var by v2.1.198 complementing CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BYTE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.summary: Byte-level stream idle-watchdog timeout, default 300000ms via Statsig, clamped [10000, 1800000]; takes precedence over the legacy CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS.

entries.name: CLAUDE_ENABLE_BYTE_WATCHDOG
entries.summary: Kill/force switch for the byte-level idle watchdog (on by default for SSE).

entries.name: CLAUDE_ENABLE_BYTE_WATCHDOG_BEDROCK
entries.summary: Opt-in byte watchdog for the Bedrock eventstream transport (off by default, unlike SSE).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP
entries.summary: Consecutive Stop-hook block override ceiling, default 8; <=0 disables the cap.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE
entries.summary: Required to enable auto permission mode on non-first-party/non-anthropicAws providers (first-party has it always available).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_GATEWAY
entries.summary: Present only in the env-name allowlist and never actually read; does NOT select the new Cloud-gateway OAuth provider (that is chosen via /login). Dead/reserved.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS
entries.summary: Pure-env truthy gate (default OFF) enabling org-managed skills reconcile from Console, with a 10-minute re-sync.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGINS
entries.summary: Pure-env truthy gate (default OFF) enabling org-managed plugins reconcile from Console, plus MCP reconcile.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGINS_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.summary: MCP-reconcile timeout bound for org-managed plugin sync, default 10000ms; tengu_plugins_sync_mcp_skipped fires only when explicitly set to 0.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGINS_INSTALL_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.summary: Plugin-install timeout bound for org-managed plugin sync, default 30000ms.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.summary: Skills-sync startup-wait bound for org-managed skills sync, default 5000ms.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE_SKILL
entries.summary: Suppresses the dark-launched built-in "claude-code-docs" CLI-as-skill (registerClaudeCodeSkill, default off via tengu_birch_kettle).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SDK_HAS_OAUTH_REFRESH
entries.summary: Capability flag: an embedding host (Desktop, VS Code, local-agent) supplies a getOAuthToken callback for SDK-embedded sessions.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SDK_HAS_HOST_AUTH_REFRESH
entries.summary: Capability flag: an embedding host supplies a getHostAuthToken callback; covers a narrower entrypoint set than OAuth refresh (excludes claude-vscode).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_AUTH_ENV_VAR
entries.summary: Names the env var holding the host-managed auth token, default ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN; its presence flips managedByHost.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_AUTH_REFRESH_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.summary: Overrides the default 30000ms timeout on the host_auth_token_refresh / oauth_token_refresh control-request RPCs.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_AUTH_SNAPSHOT_PATH
entries.summary: Single-use on-disk credential handoff for background workers: path is read, the env var deleted, and the file unlinked after installing {accessToken, scopes, subscriptionType, rateLimitTier}.

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID
entries.summary: Workspace-disambiguation var read in OIDC env-quad mode alongside organization_id/federation_rule_id. NOT the Cowork Spaces id, despite the name overlap.

provenance.note: confirmed still the L86 OIDC var, not the Spaces id

entries.name: CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR
entries.summary: Relocates secure credential storage away from the default ~/.claude.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST
entries.summary: Truthy forces managedByHost auth mode even without CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_AUTH_ENV_VAR being set.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_VIEW
entries.summary: Disables the "agent view" (renamed from CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENTS_FLEET/"Fleet view"); the underlying `claude agents` command behavior is unchanged, only naming.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT_VIEW_RELAUNCH
entries.summary: One-shot marker set around the Fleet->agent-view rename migration.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_SESSION_PERMISSION_RULES
entries.summary: JSON {allow[],deny[]} injected as session-scoped alwaysAllow/alwaysDenyRules for bg sessions only (SESSION_KIND==="bg"); user-configured, not a hardcoded always-ask list.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_TCC_DISCLAIMED
entries.summary: macOS one-shot marker for native self-respawn after a TCC (privacy permission) disclaim.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SUPERVISED
entries.summary: When set, an uncaught exception triggers a clean exit instead of a crash dump, for a supervising process to restart.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SPAWN_TIMESTAMP_MS
entries.summary: Records the process spawn timestamp (ms).

entries.name: CLAUDE_PTY_HOST_EXEC
entries.summary: PTY host executable path used by the internal --bg-pty-host argv mode.

entries.name: CLAUDE_PTY_ORPHAN_CHECK_MS
entries.summary: PTY orphan-check polling interval, default 2000ms.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BRIDGE_REATTACH_OUTBOUND_ONLY
entries.summary: Restricts bridge reattach to outbound-only connections.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_KEEPALIVE
entries.summary: Force-enables the /loop keepalive fallback wakeup (over the tengu_kairos_loop_keepalive Statsig default false); strictly subordinate to dynamic-loop mode.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLAN_MODE_INTERVIEW_PHASE
entries.summary: The interactive "interview" phase on entering plan mode is fully removed in v2.1.159, along with its two telemetry flags.

entries.name: CLAUDE_MEMORY_STORES
entries.summary: JSON array mounting multiple team-memory stores (path string or {path, mode: rw|ro, mount}); duplicate mounts throw.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_MEMORY_TOGGLED_OFF
entries.summary: Propagates a memory-off state into background child sessions.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_PEWTER_OWL
entries.summary: Hard on/off override for the PEWTER_OWL gate layer over the internal SendUserMessage/Brief tool (off-override beats all; force-on also supported).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_IS_COWORK
entries.summary: The activation marker for Cowork mode; selected by this env var, not a CLI flag (--cowork itself is rejected at agent-invocation time, plugin-scope only).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_COWORK_PLUGINS
entries.summary: Do NOT set: flips the agent user-settings file to cowork_settings.json and plugin cache to cowork_plugins/ -- files the Desktop host never populates. The real Desktop never sets it; toggling it is an active bug, not a working switch.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ALWAYS_ENABLE_EFFORT
entries.summary: Bypasses the per-model effort allowlist (effort is otherwise limited to fable-5/mythos-5/opus-4-8/opus-4-7 + select models).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_APPEND_SUBAGENT_PROMPT
entries.summary: Gates appendSubagentSystemPrompt on the initialize control-request (subagent system-prompt append).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE
entries.summary: Combined with CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_HERMETIC_MODE, triggers the ap5()/xB8() filter that drops non-SDK --mcp-config servers in hermetic-remote mode; also gates several CCR-era flags (tengu_ccr_post_turn_summary, retry watchdog).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_HERMETIC_MODE
entries.summary: Paired with CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE; both required for xB8() hermetic-remote mode, which drops non-SDK --mcp-config servers.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
entries.summary: The Desktop's VM-env builder rtA() sets this to the session OAuth token for a spawned Cowork agent; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/AUTH_TOKEN/CUSTOM_HEADERS are deleted (not blanked) alongside it, so the final env has no API-key vars at all.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_WORKER_EPOCH
entries.summary: CCR worker epoch (int) passed in by the host; a stale end_session (reason:"archived") is ignored when epoch>1 so a prior lifecycle cannot kill a reattached worker. Missing/NaN throws "missing_epoch".

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT
entries.summary: Stops selecting/routing to [1m]-tagged models, for proxies/gateways without 1M-context support.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADAPTIVE_THINKING
entries.summary: Suppresses adaptive (extended) thinking even on supporting models (opus-4-6/sonnet-4-6).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LEGACY_MODEL_REMAP
entries.summary: Disables the silent old-alias -> canonical-model-ID remap; sends the exact model string as given.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_BG_CLASSIFIER_MODEL
entries.summary: Overrides the model used for the background classifier/summarizer that produces post-turn summaries for Cowork Desktop.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL
entries.summary: Overrides the model auto-mode selects.

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL
entries.summary: Fable-5 model-family override quartet (+ _NAME, _DESCRIPTION, _SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES), matching the existing OPUS/SONNET/HAIKU pattern; in the managed-settings propagation allowlist so org policy reaches subagents.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENVIRONMENT_KIND
entries.summary: Deployment-type tag: byoc | anthropic_cloud | bridge; drives the classifier-summary surface map (byoc adds "ccr", bridge adds "bridge").

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_BYOC_ENABLE_DATADOG
entries.summary: Under ENVIRONMENT_KIND=byoc, Datadog telemetry is suppressed unless this is also set.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_WORKSPACE_HOST_PATHS
entries.summary: Pipe-separated host folders the Desktop injects (userSelectedFolders.join("|")); the agent emits them as workspace.host_paths telemetry. Host-side source is a Cowork Space's folder set (Ch26/L109).

provenance.note: confirmed as the host-side surface behind a Space's folderPath set

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_CLAIM_AUTH
entries.summary: Part of the bg/Cowork auth handshake carrying host->worker claim auth; deleted from process.env immediately after read (single-use).

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_SOCKET_TOKENS_PATH
entries.summary: Part of the bg/Cowork auth handshake carrying the socket-tokens path; deleted from process.env immediately after read.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_RV_AUTH
entries.summary: Rendezvous-socket auth token for the bg/Cowork handshake; single-use, deleted after read.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_PTY_AUTH
entries.summary: PTY-socket auth token for the bg/Cowork handshake; single-use, deleted after read.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_STARTUP_WEDGE_MS
entries.summary: Startup-watchdog timeout for hung bg workers, default 45000ms; firing kills the worker.

entries.name: CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_INDEX_CONTENT
entries.summary: Injects the Cowork memory index as a raw string (non-empty = use directly, empty = disable, unset = use file path); sibling of CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_GUIDELINES.

provenance.note: Desktop counterpart is CoworkSpaces per-space auto-memory (getAutoMemoryDir)

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_XAA
entries.summary: Gates the XAA (Cross-App Authentication, SEP-990) OIDC flow for MCP OAuth; without it, any oauth.xaa server config throws.

entries.name: CLAUDE_TRUSTED_DEVICE_TOKEN
entries.summary: Injects a trusted-device token directly, skipping proactive device-trust enrollment.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DONT_INHERIT_ENV
entries.summary: Bash-tool subprocesses get an empty base env (only SHELL/GIT_EDITOR/CLAUDECODE=1) instead of inheriting process.env; hermetic shell mode.

entries.name: CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_CLIENT_APP
entries.summary: Appended as client-app/<val> in the User-Agent/x-app header for Agent SDK integrations.

entries.name: CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_VERSION
entries.summary: Appended as agent-sdk/<val> in the User-Agent header.

entries.name: CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_MCP_NO_PREFIX
entries.summary: Suppresses the tool-name prefix for MCP tools on sdk-type connections.

entries.name: CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_DISABLE_BUILTIN_AGENTS
entries.summary: With the multi-agent fork gate, returns an empty built-in-agents list for SDK integrations.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLAN_V2_AGENT_COUNT
entries.summary: Overrides the Dynamic-Workflow (plan-v2) main parallel-agent count (default tier-based: enterprise/team 3, else 1).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_EXPLORE_AGENT_COUNT
entries.summary: Overrides the Dynamic-Workflow explore parallel-agent count; L108 shorthand renders this as CLAUDE_CODE_PLAN_V2_..._EXPLORE_AGENT_COUNT while L111 gives the standalone name -- treat as the same explore-fan-out override, exact full identifier unconfirmed.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_COLD_COMPACT
entries.summary: Triggers cold compaction (discard the whole in-flight conversation) instead of normal summary-preserving autocompact.

entries.name: CLAUDE_AFTER_LAST_COMPACT
entries.summary: Appends {after_last_compact:true} to the skill/plugin-registry API query (skill sync after compaction).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS
entries.summary: Three-way toggle for Git guidance in the system prompt (truthy=off, falsy-string=force-on, unset=policy default).

entries.name: CLAUDE_AI_URL
entries.summary: Desktop-only: overrides the claude.ai base URL (staging/localhost detection); explicitly stripped before spawning the agent.

entries.name: CLAUDE_EXTRA_HEADERS_TOKEN
entries.summary: Desktop-only: a signed JWT (verified against an embedded public key) injecting extra HTTP headers into API requests; rejected tokens just warn.

entries.name: CLAUDE_UPDATER_TOKEN
entries.summary: Desktop-only: a signed JWT overriding the auto-updater config (server URL/channel).

entries.name: CLAUDE_DESKTOP_LOCAL_FRAME_SHELL
entries.summary: Desktop-only: "=1" enables the local-frame-shell render path (embedded webviews; alters link-click handling and CSP for sub-frames).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TASKS
entries.summary: Gates the agent-side Tasks tool family (TaskCreate/TaskList/TaskGet/TaskUpdate/TaskStop/TaskOutput), decision fn vv(); pairs with CLAUDE_CODE_TASK_LIST_ID (D$()). Behind the force-ON tasks_tab experiment (gate 364911507).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_TASK_LIST_ID
entries.summary: Pins the persistent task-list id for the Tasks tool family; same insider-experiment posture as CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TASKS.

entries.name: CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS
entries.summary: When truthy, auto-moves long-running work to a background task after ~120s (Rbm()).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS
entries.summary: Suppresses the "run_in_background: true" hint injected into a tool description, hiding the background-task affordance.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_BG_TASKS_REPORT_RUNNING
entries.summary: Keeps a session's status as "not idle" while its background tasks are still running.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_SDK_FILE_CHECKPOINTING
entries.summary: Enables SDK file checkpointing/rewind (the rewind_files control-request + file_snapshot system message); overridden off by CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_CHECKPOINTING.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_CHECKPOINTING
entries.summary: Kill switch overriding CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_SDK_FILE_CHECKPOINTING.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_REMOTE_RECAP
entries.summary: Enables the remote/away recap path, pairing with the away_summary control-protocol subtype; extends the L101 proactive-away-summary feature to the remote/Cowork surface.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_DESIGN_MCP
entries.summary: Enables the Claude Design MCP server backing /design; gated off by default alongside pNe() and the other ENABLE_DESIGN_* vars.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_DESIGN_SYNC
entries.summary: Enables /design-sync (push design-system components to claude.ai/design).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DESIGN_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
entries.summary: OAuth client id used by the /design-login flow.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT
entries.summary: Force enable/disable the Artifact tool in otherwise-excluded entrypoints; master reachability is still the tengu_cobalt_plinth GB flag (default false).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ARTIFACT
entries.summary: Kill switch for the Artifact tool (pairs with the disableArtifact setting).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACTS_API_BASE_URL
entries.summary: Artifacts upload API base URL; stripped from child-process environments.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_DIRECT_UPLOAD
entries.summary: Chooses the inline direct-upload lane vs redeploy for Artifacts (tengu_cobalt_plinth_direct).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_AUTO_OPEN
entries.summary: Suppresses auto-opening the surfaced Artifact frame.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_LAUNCH_COMPOSER
entries.summary: Enables the dark-launched Launch Composer prompt-composer UI (not in the official changelog).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LAUNCH_COMPOSER
entries.summary: Disables Launch Composer.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MEMORY_BULK_INFLATE
entries.summary: Disables the auto-memory "bulk inflate" knowledge-base load path.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MEMORY_PERIODIC_RESYNC
entries.summary: Disables periodic re-sync of the memory-store knowledge base.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_EVALUATE_MEMORY
entries.summary: Forces the memory-evaluation pass.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_MEMORY_SURVEY
entries.summary: Forces the L90 Approve/Reject memory-write survey dialog to appear.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_KB_COHESION_FIXES
entries.summary: Toggles knowledge-base cohesion fixes in the memory pipeline.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_REFUSAL_FALLBACK
entries.summary: Opts out of the refusal->fallback model path (the model_refusal_fallback control-subtype family).

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_AUTH_TOKEN
entries.summary: Removed in the v2.1.160-198 CLI content refresh.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT_LIST_IN_MESSAGES
entries.summary: Removed in the v2.1.160-198 CLI content refresh.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_TEAM_ONBOARDING
entries.summary: Removed in the v2.1.160-198 refresh; was the machinery behind the earlier /team-onboarding command.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS
entries.summary: New settings-backed disableBundledSkills toggle.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS
entries.summary: Disables mouse-click handling in the TUI.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE
entries.summary: Presence-file path used to suppress mobile push notifications when a local client is active.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SAFE_MODE
entries.summary: Env equivalent of --safe-mode: starts the session with all customizations disabled (the same I5() safe mode that drops --mcp-config).

entries.name: /fork
entries.summary: Spawns a background subagent inheriting the full parent conversation (kind:"fork"); interactive-only, gated by CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT env override or the tengu_copper_fox GB flag. Confirmed live since v2.1.117 in the L89 status table.

entries.name: /autocompact
entries.summary: Configures the auto-compact window size ([auto|<tokens>]). Removed in v2.1.117, then re-introduced token-count-parameterized and unconditionally live in v2.1.119.

entries.name: /stop-hook
entries.summary: Set a session-only Stop hook with a quick prompt; already disabled (isEnabled:()=>false) before removal, gone entirely (with its telemetry) in v2.1.117.

entries.name: /model
entries.summary: Gains a second, non-interactive registration (supportsNonInteractive:true) alongside the pre-existing interactive menu, enabling `claude -p "/model sonnet" ...` scripting.

entries.name: /usage
entries.summary: Absorbs /cost and /stats as aliases; gains dual registrations (interactive ink dashboard vs supportsNonInteractive headless cost+duration string).

entries.name: /cost
entries.summary: Standalone registration deleted in v2.1.118; folded into /usage as an alias (still resolves for scripts).

entries.name: /stats
entries.summary: Standalone registration deleted in v2.1.118; folded into /usage as an alias.

entries.name: /autofix-pr
entries.summary: Description "deremoted" from "Spawn a remote Claude Code session..." to "Monitor and autofix any issues with the current PR" in v2.1.118, continuing the Remote Workflow sunset framing.

entries.name: /pro-trial-expired
entries.summary: Options shown when the Pro plan Claude Code trial has ended; isEnabled:()=>false, currently inert.

entries.name: /background
entries.summary: Alias /bg; forks the current main session into the background as a kind:"fork" subagent. Per-command isEnabled is always true but the master command-resolver array only includes it when tengu_slate_meadow (default false) is on -- live for Claude Max/Cowork accounts, "Unknown command" otherwise.

entries.name: /stop
entries.summary: Stops the current background session (transcript+worktree kept); isEnabled only true when SESSION_KIND==="bg", which is itself reachable only via the tengu_slate_meadow-gated /background.

entries.name: /daemon
entries.summary: Ink TUI for managing assistant/scheduled/remote-control services; the gate function is a hardcoded `function OqH(){return false}` (not a flippable GB flag), so it is "Unknown command" for everyone in v2.1.119 and v2.1.120.

entries.name: /schedule
entries.summary: Create/update/list/run scheduled agents; terminology shifted "triggers"->"routines" and gained one-time scheduling in v2.1.117; the conditional description was collapsed to a single cron-only string in v2.1.120 (functionality unchanged, description simplified only).

entries.name: /workflows
entries.summary: Run-history browser for Dynamic Workflows (local-jsx, isEnabled:()=>AW()); AW() defaults ON for non-pro/unauthenticated, OFF for pro accounts.

entries.name: /commit
entries.summary: Removed as a builtin in v2.1.159; migrated to the commit-commands plugin.

entries.name: /commit-push-pr
entries.summary: Removed as a builtin in v2.1.159; migrated to the commit-commands plugin.

entries.name: /extra-usage
entries.summary: Renamed to /usage-credits; kept as a hidden alias so old scripts keep working.

entries.name: /usage-credits
entries.summary: New name for the rename of /extra-usage (kept as a hidden alias).

entries.name: /scroll-speed
entries.summary: New terminal-gated command to set scroll speed (tengu_scroll_speed_set).

entries.name: /wellbeing
entries.summary: Break reminders / quiet hours; isEnabled:()=>false, dark-launched.

entries.name: /remote-control
entries.summary: Not removed (an earlier diff flagged it as removed due to a dynamic-ternary description change); exists dark-launched, surfaced today only via the idle-time "control this session from your phone" upsell toast.

entries.name: /dream
entries.summary: NOT removed: reclassified from a `name:"dream"` command registration to a built-in routine (clustered with /catch-up, /morning-checkin on a cron), so the diff tool flagged a false "removal".

entries.name: /cd
entries.summary: Moves the session to a new working directory without breaking the prompt cache.

entries.name: /rewind
entries.summary: Gains the ability to resume a conversation from before a /clear was run, in addition to its existing checkpoint/undo aliases.

entries.name: /config
entries.summary: Gains a [key=value] argument form letting any setting be set directly from the prompt.

entries.name: /bridge-kick
entries.summary: Removed in the v2.1.160-198 CLI content refresh.

entries.name: /init-verifiers
entries.summary: Removed in the v2.1.160-198 CLI content refresh.

entries.name: /simplify
entries.summary: Removed in the v2.1.160-198 CLI content refresh.

entries.name: /design
entries.summary: Hub for Claude Design (claude.ai/design): create/import/export/sync/login; grants or revokes agent access to Design projects. Dark-launched, absent from the official CHANGELOG.

entries.name: /design-sync
entries.summary: Pushes design-system components to claude.ai/design; isEnabled:pNe (off by default).

entries.name: /design-login
entries.summary: Authorizes design-system access for /design-sync via an OAuth flow.

entries.name: /plan-artifact
entries.summary: Publishes a plan as a shareable Artifact; hard-disabled via isEnabled:v5e (function always returns false) -- reports "plan-artifact slot not registered."

entries.name: /skill-doctor
entries.summary: Shows which loaded skills are unused and costing context; isEnabled:()=>true, live despite being absent from the official CHANGELOG.

entries.name: /toggle-memory
entries.summary: Renamed to /pause-memory (kept as an alias, not deleted) in the v2.1.160-198 CLI content refresh.

entries.name: /pause-memory
entries.summary: Pauses automemory for the session; aliases include memory-pause and toggle-memory (the rename target of the removed /toggle-memory name).

entries.name: /cowork-plugin
entries.summary: userInvocable:false; isEnabled only when CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT==="remote_cowork" -- an internal, non-user-facing command.

entries.name: /auto-mode-setup
entries.summary: Requires a workspace context (requires:{workspace:true}); not a GB-flag dark launch, just conditionally available.

entries.name: 2307090146 (cli_plugin)
entries.summary: CLI-plugin credential broker master gate -- OFF in live fcache captures 2026-06 and 2026-07-02; when off, renderer strips plugin.json `clis` and PKr returns oauth_disabled.

entries.name: 1143815894 (host-loop)
entries.summary: Decides host-loop vs VM-loop execution for Cowork sessions (f_()->cPt()->dt(this)); ON (force) in the live fcache, so production Cowork runs host-loop -- only requireCoworkFullVmSandbox orgs get VM-loop.

entries.name: 3045399524 (Fable model allow)
entries.summary: Whitelists claude-fable-5 (+ the [1m] variant) as selectable in Desktop/Cowork; ON (force). By the 2026-07-02 capture this makes Fable 5 the live production Cowork model.

entries.name: 583857784 (bridge transport SDK adapter)
entries.summary: Routes Cowork sessions through the SDK-based bridge transport (Bfn) instead of the legacy CCR HTTP transport (Rfn); ON (force), the current production transport path.

entries.name: 1978029737 (Cowork runtime config)
entries.summary: Master Cowork tuning gate: sessionsBridgePollBlockMs, coworkNativeFilePreview, coworkWebFetchViaApi, coworkWebFetchPrompt, workspaceBashWaitLonger. ON (force); the in-VM agent itself also reads this gate for web_fetch routing.

entries.name: 1648655587 (task dispatch rate-limiter)
entries.summary: {perTask:1, global:3} -- a dispatch session launches at most 1 sub-task and at most 3 concurrently, globally. ON (force), a real throughput ceiling on Cowork task dispatch.

entries.name: 1893165035 (auto-retry error categories)
entries.summary: categories:[api_prompt_too_long, process_already_running, api_model_not_found, api_request_too_large] are auto-retried; ON (force). Note api_model_not_found being auto-retried can mask model unavailability.

entries.name: 2340532315 (sparkplug / plugin sync)
entries.summary: Master Cowork-plugin sync gate: startup syncPlugins(), per-session manifest load, enabled-state backfill. ON (force); OFF would show enabled_state_source:"sparkplug-off".

entries.name: 2392971184 (/rc alias + replay-user-messages)
entries.summary: Registers /rc as an alias for /remote-control, adds replay-user-messages to spawn extraArgs, and expands the OAuth scope to user:sessions:claude_code. ON (force).

entries.name: 2940196192 (coworkArtifacts)
entries.summary: Desktop-side artifacts gate: getAllWithDiskStatus(), askClaude() inference, the artifacts tool list. ON (force); distinct from the CLI's own tengu_cobalt_plinth Artifacts flag (the string coworkArtifacts is absent from the CLI bundle).

provenance.note: contrasted with the CLI's own tengu_cobalt_plinth

entries.name: 123929380 (coworkKappa)
entries.summary: A named "Kappa" skill variant plus project-mounting for non-session-typed clients; OFF (default) for the standard client.

entries.name: 364911507 (tasks_tab experiment)
entries.summary: {tasks_tab:{enabled:true, split:1, salt:"tasks_v1", insiderForce:"treatment"}} -- force-treatment for insiders only, dark-launched to the general population. The same experiment bundle force-treats echo_unified_login.

entries.name: pNe (Claude Design)
entries.summary: isEnabled gate for /design-sync and the wider Claude Design feature (claude.ai/design); off by default alongside the CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_DESIGN_* env vars.

entries.name: tengu_cobalt_plinth (Artifacts)
entries.summary: The CLI's own master gate for the Artifact tool / claude.ai/code/artifact publishing; default false (Rpa() short-circuits when off). Parallel to, and independent from, Desktop's coworkArtifacts gate (2940196192).

entries.name: oidc-federation-2026-04-01
entries.summary: Sent when OIDC Federation auth mode is active; the only API beta string added in v2.1.116.

entries.name: cache-diagnosis-2026-04-07
entries.summary: Prompt-cache diagnostics beta; sent opt-in for allowlisted accounts, gracefully dropped (and the decision persisted) if the server rejects it.

entries.name: afk-mode-2026-01-31
entries.summary: Pre-existing beta token (predates v2.1.159) newly injected by third-party-provider auto mode when CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE is set.

entries.name: code-execution-2025-08-25
entries.summary: In the default Betas=[...] array; sent by default (not GB-gated) as of v2.1.198.

entries.name: server-side-fallback-2026-06-01
entries.summary: GB-gated (sb("server_side_fallback",...)); server side of the L110 fallbackModel chain, letting the server transparently fall back to another model.

entries.name: fallback-credit-2026-06-01
entries.summary: GB-gated (sb("fallback_credit",...)); accounts for credit when the server-side-fallback beta substitutes a model.

entries.name: prompt-caching-evict-2026-05-12
entries.summary: GB-gated (sb("prompt_caching_evict",...)); enables server-side cache eviction, pairing with the earlier cache-diagnosis beta.

entries.name: initialize
entries.summary: The first control_request the driver sends, before the user turn; carries systemPrompt, appendSubagentSystemPrompt, hooks, and sdkMcpServers.

entries.name: can_use_tool
entries.summary: Baseline control-request dispatcher subtype for permission prompts; requires --permission-prompt-tool stdio on the driver side or AskUserQuestion is silently auto-dismissed.

entries.name: hook_callback
entries.summary: Control-request wire shape (2.1.197): {subtype:"hook_callback", callback_id, input, tool_use_id?}; input is the shared hook-input object (Ad()). A PreToolUse hook deny bypasses canUseTool and surfaces as an is_error tool_result.

entries.name: mcp_message
entries.summary: Tunnels JSON-RPC for an SDK-declared MCP server out to the driver; the driver replies with {mcp_response:{jsonrpc, id, result}} -- the driver IS the MCP server.

entries.name: oauth_token_refresh
entries.summary: Host-delegated OAuth token refresh RPC; response.accessToken. Default 30000ms timeout.

entries.name: host_auth_token_refresh
entries.summary: Host-delegated generic auth-token refresh RPC (sibling of oauth_token_refresh); response.authToken.

entries.name: elicitation
entries.summary: Routes an MCP server's elicitation/create request to onElicitation({serverName, message, mode, url, elicitationId, requestedSchema, ...}); the {action, content} result returns privately to the server, never entering the chat.

entries.name: mcp_call
entries.summary: Host->VM: invoke any subprocess MCP tool by fully-qualified name (mcp__server__tool) through the control channel, bypassing the model turn. Explicitly documented as having no permission check (control channel is trusted).

entries.name: request_user_dialog
entries.summary: VM->host: ask the host to render a tool-driven blocking dialog and return the choice; replaces the older setToolJSX/onDone pattern. ~6s auto-cancel; part of the async-park (Uv1) dispatcher set.

provenance.note: confirmed as the third Uv1 async-park member

entries.name: register_repo_root
entries.summary: Host->VM: add a working-directory root at runtime (must be a subdir of cwd); can carry reload_claude_md/reload_plugins/reload_skills sub-flags. Runtime hook behind multi-repo workflows.

entries.name: stage_file
entries.summary: Host->VM (CCR): stages a host file into the remote container filestore via stageFile(); companion system message files_persisted.

entries.name: end_session
entries.summary: Host->VM (CCR): terminates the worker; a reason:"archived" end_session is ignored when CLAUDE_CODE_WORKER_EPOCH>1 so a prior lifecycle cannot kill a reattached worker.

entries.name: get_session_cost
entries.summary: Host->VM: fetch the remote container's formatted session cost (same text /usage prints) so a thin client shows real cost.

entries.name: get_binary_version
entries.summary: Host->VM: returns {version, buildTime} so /version in --remote mode shows both client and remote CLI versions.

entries.name: generate_session_title
entries.summary: VM<->host: LLM-driven session titling: {description, persist?} -> {title}.

entries.name: ultrareview_launch
entries.summary: Host->VM: control-channel entry point for /ultrareview: {args, confirm} -> injects the command plus a session-URL status message, with graceful fallback if blocked.

entries.name: side_question
entries.summary: VM->host: a free-form inline question -> {response, synthetic} (synthetic:true when auto-accepted).

entries.name: elicitation_complete
entries.summary: type:"system" message: {mcp_server_name, elicitation_id} -- signals a URL-mode elicitation completed. Skipped by the headless output filter.

entries.name: files_persisted
entries.summary: type:"system" message: {files:[{filename,file_id}], failed, processed_at} -- companion to the stage_file request.

entries.name: local_command_output
entries.summary: type:"system" message: {content} -- slash-command output (e.g. /voice, /usage) piped through the SDK stream.

entries.name: api_metrics
entries.summary: type:"system" message: {ttft_ms, otps, ...} -- per-turn latency metrics.

entries.name: thinking
entries.summary: type:"system" message: {content} -- rendered thinking text.

entries.name: rewind_files
entries.summary: Rolls files back to a prior user-message checkpoint: {subtype:"rewind_files", user_message_id, dry_run}; dry_run previews without writing. Gated by CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_SDK_FILE_CHECKPOINTING.

entries.name: file_snapshot
entries.summary: System message recording a checkpoint: {subtype:"file_snapshot", content:"File snapshot", level:"info", isMeta:true}. Same gating as rewind_files.

entries.name: away_summary
entries.summary: Pairs with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_REMOTE_RECAP; extends the L101 proactive-away-summary feature to the remote/Cowork surface.

entries.name: scheduled_task_fire
entries.summary: type:"system" message the agent emits when a Desktop-scheduled (cron or watcher) task fires; the transcript renderer prints it as a dim status line. Scheduling/watching lives host-side; the agent only receives and surfaces the fire event.

entries.name: task_started (Tasks-tool family)
entries.summary: Consolidated entry for the Tasks-tool control-protocol event family: background_tasks, task_started, task_progress, task_updated, task_summary, task_notification, stop_task -- all tied to the CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TASKS-gated Tasks tool and the force-ON tasks_tab insider experiment (gate 364911507).

entries.name: memory_recall / memory_saved
entries.summary: The agent surfaces memory recall/save events to the host -- the UI-facing side of the L90 memory-write Approve/Reject survey.

entries.name: model_fallback family
entries.summary: Consolidated entry for model_fallback, model_consent_fallback, model_refusal_fallback, model_refusal_no_fallback -- pairs with the L110 fallbackModel setting and the L113 server-side-fallback/fallback-credit betas; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_REFUSAL_FALLBACK opts out of the refusal branch.

entries.name: CoworkSpaces
entries.summary: New Desktop IPC interface (24 validated methods) organizing projects/folders/links/remote-sessions into a Space, with per-space auto-memory (getAutoMemoryDir/readSpaceMemoryIndex) and auto-organization (classifySessions/setAutoDescription/summarizeSpace). Did not exist at the Ch24/L107 baseline. UI reachability (coworkTabEnabled) is a separate server-side gate from the interface's presence.

entries.name: CoworkScheduledTasks (aka CCDScheduledTasks)
entries.summary: New Desktop IPC interface (9 validated methods) driving cron and watched tasks that fire agent sessions on a timer/trigger; tasks carry Chrome permissions. Governed by gates scheduledTasksWakeEnabled/scheduledTaskStaleReapEnabled/coworkScheduledTasksEnabled/ccdScheduledTasksEnabled.

entries.name: LocalPlugins
entries.summary: Preload IPC namespace (mainView.js) exposing setPluginEnvVars/getPluginCliStatus/getPluginOAuthStatus/setPluginOAuthClient/startPluginOAuthFlow/revokePluginOAuth/getPluginShimOps/getPluginCliBatch for the clis.*.env credential broker; functionally dark, since the runtime chokepoint PKr returns oauth_disabled while gate 2307090146 (cli_plugin) is off.

entries.name: Workflow
entries.summary: Runs a deterministic multi-agent JS script with journal-resume and a 1000-agent hard cap; gated by AW(), which defaults ON for non-pro/unauthenticated accounts and OFF for pro.

entries.name: TeamCreate
entries.summary: Coordinator-mode worker-team management tool; removed in v2.1.178 -- every session now has one implicit team.

entries.name: TeamDelete
entries.summary: Coordinator-mode worker-team management tool; removed alongside TeamCreate in v2.1.178.

entries.name: Brief
entries.summary: Internal, non-user-invokable "send a visible message to the user" tool; renamed to SendUserMessage back in v2.1.138 (predates this chapter's v2.1.159 scope) with Brief kept as an alias. v2.1.159 adds the PEWTER_OWL gate layer on top, not a further rename.

entries.name: TaskCreate
entries.summary: Part of the deferred Tasks tool family (with TaskList/TaskGet/TaskUpdate/TaskStop/TaskOutput); gated by CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TASKS and the force-ON tasks_tab insider experiment (gate 364911507).

entries.name: TaskList
entries.summary: Part of the deferred Tasks tool family; see tool.TaskCreate for gating.

entries.name: TaskGet
entries.summary: Part of the deferred Tasks tool family; see tool.TaskCreate for gating.

entries.name: TaskUpdate
entries.summary: Part of the deferred Tasks tool family; see tool.TaskCreate for gating.

entries.name: TaskStop
entries.summary: Part of the deferred Tasks tool family; see tool.TaskCreate for gating.

entries.name: TaskOutput
entries.summary: Part of the deferred Tasks tool family; see tool.TaskCreate for gating.

entries.name: DesignSync
entries.summary: Backs /design-sync (push design-system components to claude.ai/design); gated off by default (pNe()).

entries.name: Artifact
entries.summary: Publishes a shareable web page to https://claude.ai/code/artifact/<slug>; master gate is the GrowthBook flag tengu_cobalt_plinth (default false). Excludes local-agent/claude-coworker* entrypoints even when on.

entries.name: MessageDisplay
entries.summary: The 30th entry in the master hook-event array; fires as an assistant message streams (and once when complete) and can rewrite the on-screen delta via hookSpecificOutput.displayContent WITHOUT changing the stored transcript. Config-gated only (no Statsig flag) -- disabled unless a hook is configured. Earlier chapter counts of "27"/"19" were diff-tool undercounts, not real historical totals.

Gates a browser-preview-related feature; guard requires this gate AND sessionType==="ccd" AND not-SSH. Found riding in the same hardcodedMainGrowthBookFeatures force-on table as cli_plugin (2307090146), scoped to the 3p/CCD deployment class only.
Gates canSaveSkill. Same force-on table as cli_plugin (2307090146), 3p/CCD-class only.
Gates whether CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_GUIDELINES (lesson 90) is constructed at spawn time at all. Same force-on table as cli_plugin (2307090146), 3p/CCD-class only.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_QUESTION_PREVIEW_FORMAT
entries.summary: Set from Desktop settings (askUserQuestion.previewFormat) at Cowork session spawn; the settings->env wiring behind lesson 107's AskUserQuestion reachability documentation.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_ASK_USER_QUESTION_TOOL
entries.summary: Set unconditionally to "true" in the main Cowork spawn env. Not previously named as its own enable-flag; lesson 107 only documented --permission-prompt-tool stdio as the mechanism keeping AskUserQuestion from being silently auto-dismissed.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY
entries.summary: Fallback set to "1" in the Cowork spawn env when no memory path is resolvable; sibling of CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_PATH_OVERRIDE.

entries.name: CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_PATH_OVERRIDE
entries.summary: The concrete env-var wiring between lesson 109's CoworkSpaces.getAutoMemoryDir (Space-scoped auto-memory directory) and the agent's Cowork spawn env.

provenance.note: completes the getAutoMemoryDir IPC method documented there

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON
entries.summary: Two distinct meanings under one name. CLI-side (lesson 38): the AGENT_TRIGGERS/tengu_kairos_cron kill switch. Desktop-side (lesson 114): a session-scoped `disableCron` setting set at Cowork session spawn (`A.disableCron?"1":""`), forced true in background/ephemeral spawn helpers -- plausibly what keeps lesson 109's Scheduled Tasks from firing inside ephemeral/non-interactive Cowork spawns. Do not conflate the two.

provenance.note: Desktop/Cowork-session-scoped meaning, distinct from the CLI AGENT_TRIGGERS sense

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENTS_FLEET
entries.summary: Lesson 100 documented this only as the old, renamed-away name for CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_VIEW (Fleet view -> agent view rename). Still live for a narrower purpose: set to "1" alongside CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS in a Tasks-tool-child spawn path, suppressing nested Fleet/backgrounding from sub-tasks. The primary UI toggle renamed; this one spawn-path usage did not.

provenance.note: documented only as the old name of DISABLE_AGENT_VIEW
confirmed still live for Tasks-tool-child nested-Fleet suppression

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL
entries.summary: Promoted from speculative to confirmed. Lesson 46 catalogued this only as an unreleased precedence-order entry with no evidence anything set it. Lesson 114 confirms it is genuinely wired in the Desktop Cowork spawn path, reading a real defaultSubagentModel settings field.

provenance.note: confirmed wired to a real Desktop settings field

entries.name: MCP_LIST_SCHEDULED_TASKS
entries.summary: A 5th scheduled-tasks tool alongside lesson 109's CREATE/UPDATE/START_WATCHING/STOP_WATCHING. List-only, lower-privilege; confirmed NOT part of the 8-tool Desktop forced-ask matcher.

entries.name: mcp__cowork__propose_skills
entries.summary: A cowork-namespaced MCP tool found in the same string-table region as save_skill/launch_code_session; not in the 8-tool forced-ask matcher.

entries.name: mcp__cowork__send_user_message
entries.summary: A cowork-namespaced MCP tool found alongside propose_skills/present_files; not in the 8-tool forced-ask matcher.

entries.name: mcp__cowork__present_files
entries.summary: Promotes a scratchpad file to the outputs/artifacts area (log line: "[present_files] Promoted scratchpad file..."); not in the 8-tool forced-ask matcher.
